data.body: Phase-1 RCA (confirmed before repair): Gerrit Verified run 31726058931 failed identically in all four matrix cells before pytest. The runtime gate reported `src/rebar/_config_schema.py` at 808 LOC against the locked 800-LOC cap. The triggering main commit d2dea317ec added eight schema lines after prior work had exhausted headroom; change 1730's importer code never ran. A direct RED oracle in the fresh worktree reproduces `assert 808 <= 800`. The changeable artifact is the inline `_SECTIONS` registry at `src/rebar/_config_schema.py:605-742`, an existing independent seam that can move without changing its 97-key coercion contract. Alternative causes (importer behavior, platform/Python version, pytest) are ruled out by the pre-test, cross-platform identical failure. Defect legitimacy: this violates the locked module-size contract in `tests/unit/test_module_size_contract.py` and AGENTS.md. Expected repair behavior: the schema module is below 800 LOC while every registry key/coercer remains observable through the existing import paths.
